title: The newspaper ad that created Barça

segments.say: On 29 November, Barça turns 127 years old.
And it all started with a newspaper advert placed by a Swiss man called Joan Gamper.
He was looking for players to start a brand new football club in the city.
On 29 November 1899, Futbol Club Barcelona was born.
Those famous blue and garnet colours? One popular theory links them to Gamper's old club, FC Basel.
More than a century later, Barça is still owned by its members. That's why it's more than a club.
